subject: [Approval] runtime-1.21: ramp tiered batching defaults flag to 5% (us-west) + rollback owner confirmation
body:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Benji Okafor <benji.okafor@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 9:44 AM PST
Subject: [Approval] runtime-1.21: ramp tiered batching defaults flag to 5% (us-west) + rollback owner confirmation

Hi Mateo + Priya,

Requesting approval to ramp the runtime-1.21 flag for tiered batching defaults in Hosted (us-west) today.

Proposal (per launch brief):
- Flag: runtime.tiered_batching_defaults
- Scope: Hosted only, us-west, chat + completions routes
- Models: rw-openchat-70b, rw-llama3-8b (top two by volume)
- Default tier: standard (no customer config changes; explicit batching configs continue to override)
- Ramp: 0% -> 1% for 30 min -> 5% for 2 hrs (hold), then decide on 10% later/tomorrow

Go/no-go checks:
- Perf canary: green as of this morning (no p95 regression > 3% on standard tier)
- Known risk: tail spikes if queue delay is miscalibrated under bursty concurrency; mitigated by overload protection hooks + rollback automation

Monitoring (owners in cc):
- Grafana: Tiered Batching Rollout Overview dashboard
- Key abort signals (any sustained over 10 min):
  - p95 latency +10% vs control on either model
  - timeouts or cancellations +0.2% absolute
  - queue_delay_p95 > 35ms sustained on standard tier
  - error rate +0.1% absolute (5xx)

Need explicit confirmation on rollback ownership and permission to ramp.

If approved, I’ll coordinate the ramp in the 10:30a–12:30p window and post status in #eng-releases.

Thanks,
Connor
—
Connor O'Brien
Release Engineering, Redwood Inference


From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Benji Okafor <benji.okafor@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 10:02 AM PST
Subject: Re: [Approval] runtime-1.21: ramp tiered batching defaults flag to 5% (us-west) + rollback owner confirmation

Confirming SRE rollback owner: me (on-call) for today.

Rollback plan:
- Flip runtime.tiered_batching_defaults to 0% in the flag console (Benji’s tooling)
- Expect effect within ~2–5 minutes (depends on config refresh interval)
- If we see elevated timeouts, we’ll also temporarily lower admission control threshold back to baseline for those two models

I’ll stay on the dashboard during the ramp window and call abort if any of the abort signals hit.

Rafael


From: Benji Okafor <benji.okafor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 10:11 AM PST
Subject: Re: [Approval] runtime-1.21: ramp tiered batching defaults flag to 5% (us-west) + rollback owner confirmation

+1, flag is ready.

Notes:
- Flag can target by {region, model, route} and supports holdback/control split.
- Rollback is single toggle; no redeploy.
- Audit log entries will record who changed the percentage and when.

One small suggestion: keep a stable 95/5 split for at least 90 minutes before moving further, so we can compare p95/timeout deltas with enough volume.

Benji


From: Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Benji Okafor <benji.okafor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 10:26 AM PST
Subject: Re: [Approval] runtime-1.21: ramp tiered batching defaults flag to 5% (us-west) + rollback owner confirmation

I’m good with the abort thresholds as written.

Only tweak I’d ask for: when you post status updates, include queue_delay_p95 and batch_size_p50 for the treated cohort (standard tier), since we’ve seen noisy latency without obvious GPU util changes.

Allison


From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Benji Okafor <benji.okafor@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 10:41 AM PST
Subject: Re: [Approval] runtime-1.21: ramp tiered batching defaults flag to 5% (us-west) + rollback owner confirmation

Approved from runtime side for the 1% -> 5% ramp, with Rafael as rollback owner.

Condition: if the treated cohort shows any streaming cadence issues (token cadence jitter / first-token delay) on rw-openchat-70b, abort and keep it at 0% until we rerun the cadence test suite.

Please post updates in #eng-releases and tag me if you see anything ambiguous.

Mateo


From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Benji Okafor <benji.okafor@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 11:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: [Approval] runtime-1.21: ramp tiered batching defaults flag to 5% (us-west) + rollback owner confirmation

Approved.

Thanks for tightening the plan and making rollback ownership explicit. Keep it conservative today (hold at 5% until we have clean numbers).

Priya


From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Benji Okafor <benji.okafor@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Mar 5, 2025 at 12:18 PM PST
Subject: Re: [Approval] runtime-1.21: ramp tiered batching defaults flag to 5% (us-west) + rollback owner confirmation

Thanks all — proceeding.

Plan for today (updated):
- 10:30–11:00: 1% treated, validate: p95/p99, timeouts, queue_delay_p95, batch_size_p50, streaming first-token delay
- 11:00–12:30: 5% treated (stable 95/5 split per Benji)
- Hold at 5% pending review; no move to 10% today unless all signals are clean

I’ll post updates in #eng-releases with the requested metrics.

Connor
